species.name: Slipknot

dex.text: More knot than creature, and entirely at ease with that. If you manage to pick it up, it will not be in your hands for long.
dex.fact: Hagfish tie themselves into knots, which helps them wipe off their own slime and get leverage on food.

species.real: A hagfish in trouble can turn the water around it to slime in a fraction of a second.

species.name: Gordian

dex.text: Tied itself in a knot so tight that nobody, including Alexander the Great, is going to try cutting it. Smells of the sea bottom and holds a grudge.
dex.fact: Hagfish have no jaws; they feed by rasping with toothed plates on their tongue, often on dead fish on the sea floor.

species.real: Hagfish live on the cold seabed, including in Scottish sea lochs, and are not true eels.
